description: Translate ALL source code to target language - every function, every line, producing runnable code

fundamental_requirement.statement: This step produces COMPLETE, RUNNABLE code - not stubs, not interfaces, not partial implementations
fundamental_requirement.verification: At the end of this step, you must be able to execute the translated application and it must work
failure_conditions: Any function with 'pass' or empty body
Any TODO comments instead of actual code

required.description: Mapping of source functions to target services/modules from LM-04.5
Type and pattern mappings from LM-04
Interface contracts to preserve from LM-03

source_code.description: The actual source code to translate

artifacts.description: COMPLETE implementation in target language - all functions, all logic
Tests translated to target language test framework
Log of each function translated with source->target mapping

actions.action: Load function mapping and identify ALL functions to translate
actions.llm_guidance: Create an explicit list of EVERY function that needs translation. This is your checklist - every item must be completed. No exceptions.

actions.description: Convert all structs, classes, enums, constants to target language
actions.llm_guidance:
For each data type in the source:
- Create equivalent type in target language
- Preserve all fields and their types
- Translate any methods on the type
- Handle inheritance/composition patterns

Example (C++ to Python):
struct Point { int x; int y; } -> @dataclass class Point: x: int; y: int

actions.description: Create function declarations with proper types
actions.llm_guidance:
For each function:
- Translate parameter types
- Translate return type
- Preserve function semantics (pure, stateful, etc.)
- Add type hints in target language

actions.description: THE CRITICAL STEP: Translate the full implementation of every function
actions.llm_guidance:
This is the most important action. For EACH function:

1. READ the entire source function
2. UNDERSTAND what it does (all branches, all logic)
3. TRANSLATE line-by-line or algorithmically:
   - All control flow (if/else, loops, switch)
   - All arithmetic and logic
   - All function calls (map to target equivalents)
   - All error handling
   - All edge cases

4. HANDLE complex patterns:
   - goto -> while loops or state machines
   - macros -> inline code or functions
   - pointer arithmetic -> array indexing
   - global state -> explicit parameters

5. VERIFY the translation:
   - Same number of code paths
   - Same logic in each path
   - Same error conditions

DO NOT:
- Add 'pass' or empty bodies
- Raise NotImplementedError
- Add TODO comments
- Skip 'complex' functions
- Create partial implementations

actions.description: Convert test files to target language test framework
actions.llm_guidance: Translate existing tests to target test framework (e.g., pytest for Python). Add new tests to cover critical paths.

actions.description: Generate project structure and build files
actions.llm_guidance:
Create appropriate build configuration:
- Python: pyproject.toml with all dependencies
- Rust: Cargo.toml
- Go: go.mod
- etc.

Include all dependencies needed to build and run.

actions.description: Compile/parse the translated code to verify syntax
actions.llm_guidance:
Run the build:
- Python: python -m py_compile *.py
- Rust: cargo build
- Go: go build

Fix ANY syntax errors before proceeding.

actions.description: Execute the translated application to verify it runs
actions.llm_guidance:
Run the application entry point:
- It should start without crashing
- Basic functionality should work
- If it's a CLI, run with --help
- If it's a service, verify it starts

This is the VERIFICATION that translation is complete.
Run all translated tests. Fix any failures. All tests should pass.
If possible, run both source and target with same inputs and compare outputs. Document any intentional differences.

Create specs/migration/translation_log.json with:
- List of all functions translated
- Source file -> Target file mapping
- Any refactoring decisions made
- Any intentional behavior changes

for_each_iteration: Translate all functions allocated to this service
Build and verify the service compiles
Move to next service only when current is COMPLETE
iteration_control.completion_criteria: All services translated, all code compiles, all tests pass, application runs

quality_gate.name: Complete Code Translation Gate
criteria: ALL functions from function_to_service_mapping.json have been translated
ZERO functions have empty bodies, 'pass', or NotImplementedError
ZERO TODO comments used as placeholder for code

goto.translation: Use while loop with state variable, or refactor to function calls
goto.example: state = 'start'; while True: if state == 'start': ... state = 'next'; continue

switch_fallthrough.translation: Use match/case without fallthrough, or if/elif chain

malloc_free.translation: Just use normal object creation - Python/Go have GC

pointer_arithmetic.translation: array[offset] or use numpy for numeric arrays

union.translation: Use tagged union (dataclass with type field) or typing.Union

failure_recovery.if_function_too_complex: Break into smaller helper functions, translate each
failure_recovery.if_library_not_available: Find equivalent library or implement the functionality
failure_recovery.if_pattern_unknown: Research target language idioms, ask for guidance if needed
